prompt.natural: Holographic digital address book and glowing neural sales funnel routing customer relationships into closed deals. Slow cinematic push-in ending on a golden Closed-Won ledger burst.

h3_structured.subject: A holographic digital address book floating beside a glowing neural sales funnel; luminous customer cards flow into the funnel and emerge as sealed golden deals
h3_structured.scene: Deep-navy cyberspace void (#0b0f1e) with faint grid horizon, floating UI panels of a sales pipeline
h3_structured.motion: Customer cards lift off the address book pages one by one, stream along glowing neural paths into the funnel, pulse at the deal-stage gate, then a golden burst as the deal closes
h3_structured.camera: Slow cinematic push-in from wide establishing to medium on the funnel mouth, finishing with a gentle rise as the golden burst fills frame
h3_structured.lighting: Cyan and magenta rim glow, volumetric light shafts through the funnel, warm gold accent only at the close-won burst
h3_structured.style: Holographic explainer art, sleek futuristic HUD aesthetic, no text, 16:9
h3_structured.audio: Soft ambient synth pad, subtle data-chime as each card enters the funnel, warm resolving chord on the golden burst

prompt.h3_text: Subject: a holographic digital address book floating beside a glowing neural sales funnel; luminous customer cards flow into the funnel and emerge as sealed golden deals. Scene: deep-navy cyberspace void with faint grid horizon and floating pipeline UI panels. Motion: cards lift off the pages, stream along glowing neural paths into the funnel, pulse at the stage gate, golden burst as the deal closes. Camera: slow cinematic push-in from wide to medium on the funnel mouth, gentle rise at the end. Lighting: cyan and magenta rim glow, volumetric shafts, warm gold accent at the burst. Style: holographic explainer art, sleek futuristic HUD, no text, 16:9. Audio: ambient synth pad, data-chimes per card, warm resolving chord on the burst.
prompt.negative: text, captions, watermark, logos, distorted faces, flicker, low contrast
